Game Overview

Red Square Adventure is a adventure game built around guide the Red Square through a vibrant pixelated world filled with tricky paths and daunting obstacles. Master the art of timing and precision as you navigate through challenging levels, collecting points and racing against the clock. Each level brings a fresh test of your skill and speed.
